subject.title: fix: require decimal numeric oc-path predicates

question: Should oc-path relational predicates preserve the shipped finite-Number coercion semantics, or intentionally become a strict plain-decimal grammar?
rationale: Both behaviors are mechanically implementable, but narrowing an already shipped and documented CLI grammar is a compatibility choice that code review cannot make safely without owner intent.

options.title: Preserve shipped semantics
options.body: Keep Number-plus-finite coercion and close or reshape this PR around a separately demonstrated bug that does not narrow the grammar.

options.title: Adopt strict decimal
options.body: Approve the compatibility change, update the public CLI contract, and require real CLI proof showing the intended before/after behavior.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Leave the current grammar unchanged until a broader oc-path versioning or predicate-language decision is documented.

recommendation.title: Preserve shipped semantics
recommendation.body: Keep Number-plus-finite coercion and close or reshape this PR around a separately demonstrated bug that does not narrow the grammar.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history-backed owner for the shipped oc-path CLI and its later parsing constraints.
